mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cake_movements (biz_date, cake_id, cake_size, delta, move_type, reservation_id, request_id, memo) VALUES (#{bizDate}, #{cakeId}, #{cakeSize}, #{delta}, #{moveType}, #{reservationId}, #{requestId}, #{memo})
mapper.select: SELECT m.cake_size AS cakeSize, m.cake_id AS cakeId, COALESCE(SUM(m.delta), 0) AS stock FROM cake_movements m WHERE m.biz_date = #{today} GROUP BY m.cake_size, m.cake_id
